hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "BRANCH DISCIPLINE GATE: Before creating this branch, run `gh pr list --state open` and ask two questions: (1) Is this work a hard dependency for an open PR — i.e. that PR cannot pass CI or be correct without it? (2) Does separating it into its own PR buy anything — independent reviewability, an earlier merge path, a meaningfully smaller PR? If it is a hard dependency AND separation buys nothing: checkout the existing branch and commit there. If it can stand alone and merge first: new branch is fine. If it is genuinely independent: new branch. See docs/working_agreement.md section 3a."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "MERGE BLOCKED: Running `gh pr merge` is not permitted. Merging is the user's action, not the agent's. Open the PR, ensure CI is green, and stop. The user will merge. See docs/working_agreement.md section 3."}}'  && exit 1

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "WORKFLOW GATE: git commit detected. Per working_agreement.md section 3 you MUST now complete steps 3 and 4 before responding to the user: (3) git push origin <branch> with explicit refspec, (4) gh pr create. Do not report done until the PR URL is returned."}}'
